title: Reply / forward indicators
blurb: Reply / forward icons appear inline before Subject. Outlook OAuth, Yahoo app-password and other IMAP accounts use provider \Answered and $Forwarded flags plus confirmed successful Morrow sends. After complete SMTP acceptance, Morrow saves an indicator for the exact original account, folder, UID and UIDVALIDITY, then adds the server flag where permitted. Read-only folders, unsupported keywords and failed flag writes keep the local indicator; flag errors never resubmit mail. Transient flag failures retry at most two identities per ordinary folder sync after five minutes while Morrow is running. Local evidence survives ordinary refresh and restart, but does not follow an unverified move or a recreated folder. Cross-device display requires server and client support; no new grant is requested. Gmail API has no equivalent flags: Morrow saves a local indicator only after a confirmed successful reply or forward, including Undo Send and scheduled delivery. Failed, canceled, partial or uncertain submissions add no local indicator. Historical Gmail replies can be inferred from already downloaded Sent In-Reply-To headers matching a unique original RFC Message-ID in the same account. Confirmed local replies use the verified original Gmail identity even when its Message-ID is missing. Emoji reaction MIME is excluded. While syncing Sent, Morrow checks at most two already cached, uninspected Sent reply candidates per pass within the existing twenty-message read budget. Completed MIME checks survive restart; offline or rate-limited work waits for normal sync retry. Thread membership and subject text alone are never evidence. No full mailbox scan, new permission or forward inference is used. Cross-device forwards and unbound legacy originals remain unknown. Saved local evidence survives normal syncs and restarts on this device; it is not uploaded to Gmail. For Gmail, explicit provider evidence takes priority. Both icons can appear; no prefix means unknown or no positive evidence. Local drafts and Outbox have no indicators. There is no status column or status sort. IMAP refresh rotates through up to 200 cached UIDs each pass. Icons retain accessible text and hover descriptions. Native provider and screen-reader validation remain pending.
